rationale: Record a Pulp-owned reduction in Canvas2D bridge crossings for scripted editors. CanvasWidget's replay now tracks the sticky Canvas2D drawing state it applies and re-applies what differs after each restore(), so restore() reverts drawing state identically on Skia and CoreGraphics; the web-compat Canvas2D shim therefore keeps its record of sent state across save()/restore(), caches fill colour, stroke colour and line width, and flushes pending state before save(). canvasPathPolyline gains an optional subpath-start list so disjoint subpaths batch into one call, and the JS hit-test path mirror stores flat number arrays. The change stays inside the existing CanvasWidget replay, WidgetBridge canvas2d and shim boundary, regenerates the bridge signature artifacts for the optional argument, adds no Vellum implementation or authority transfer, and leaves the accepted expansion boundary unchanged.
